title: Gluten-Free Middle Eastern Falafel Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy falafel wrap made with gluten-free ingredients, perfect for a quick lunch or snack.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Cook the falafel according to package instructions.
3. Warm the gluten-free pita bread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
4. In a small bowl, mix together the chickpeas, Middle Eastern Spice Mix, and a pinch of salt.
5. Spread a layer of velvety tahini sauce on each pita bread.
6. Add 2-3 falafel pieces on top of the tahini sauce.
7. Add a spoonful of the chickpea mix on top of the falafel.
8. Add a few slices of cucumber and a few kalamata olives on top.
9. If using feta cheese, crumble it on top.
